answer.reason: The verses tell of several events at the temple, from which the chief ones can be named.

clauses.english: was where Jesus overthrew the moneychangers' tables and drove out the sellers
clauses.quote: cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple

clauses.english: had its veil torn in two from top to bottom when Jesus died
clauses.quote: the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom

clauses.english: was foretold by Jesus to be thrown down, with no stone left on another
clauses.quote: There shall not be left here one stone upon another

doubts: Jesus's cleansing of the temple is told at two points (JHN 2 and the Synoptics); it is given here as one clause.
Many marked verses only mention the temple as a place where teaching or other events happened; they are not used as clauses.
